Kake round 38, wave 1 (build + first falsifiers). The L1 (KakeR38) holds the planner and integration seat; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin. Lane axes: operability and freshness (web properties and publishing). Each item names what it builds or attacks; attacks try to show work is wrong, overstated or harmful, with reproducible evidence. Time box: finish and write your report within 30 minutes; a partial report (first line `PARTIAL:`) beats none.

# Declared claim (SCORECARD.md "Round 38 — C2 declared", at 2dab7f3114f3e9dcf072b524c88816ab05fdfcf1; C1 was declared at b0ab7f606d1f61fb6b850785866ba71583f629cc and WITHDRAWN before any build at 2dab7f3114f3e9dcf072b524c88816ab05fdfcf1 because controls of its declared kinds met its predicate; base af43a50fa399881eead9381d835b78a015e277a6). Read: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin show 2dab7f3114f3e9dcf072b524c88816ab05fdfcf1:SCORECARD.md | sed -n '/^## Round 37 — closure correction/,$p'`.
- C2 (operability, tool repair; the redesign of C1): `scripts/robots_audit.py` gains three contract rules — (h) non-JSON number literals (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity → input_invalid) and integers of any length (out-of-range status → check_invalid; unused long numbers change nothing), (i) URL characters (ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set anywhere in `url` → check_invalid; non-ASCII kept), (k) the implicit /robots.txt allow compared on the normalized path to match. The round-37 contract ("Round 37 — declared claims") holds except where (h), (i), (k) change it. Frozen predicate `met: passed >= 20 of 20 sealed cases`; counter /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-38/sealed_count_v3.py (C1's withdrawn counter sealed_count.py stays its rule of record). Before: 8 of 20 at base. Harm instruments: round-37 counter 28/28 (key 424aa248) and `scripts/robots_audit_selftest.py` 137/137 must hold at the build.
- Round-37 closure (non-author): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/lessons/round-37-verifier-spotcheck.md — round-37 C1 NOT admitted (a stdlib-plus-patches control met its predicate before the build and the lane kept the claim). Routed defects 1–6 there are this round's repairs.
- Control receipts (committed before this wave): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-38/verification/ (control-*.json and mutref/ under C1's v2 counter; v3/*.json and c2-at-af43a50f.json under C2's v3 counter) and control seat reports /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-38/ctl/. Control tool files: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-38/retained/controls/.
- Sources registry /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/SOURCES.md (rows S001–S097; contract in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/CORPUS.md section "SOURCES.md — where a shokunin learns"). Rows this round bears on: S034 (RFC 8259), S029 and S089 (RFC 3986), S011 (RFC 9309), S095 (Google robots spec), S096 (google/robotstxt).

# Sealed key — binding
The 20 C1 and C2 cases are sealed outside the lane. Never list, read, stat, search or open anything under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38/ or /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38ctl/ (those exact directories and below; your sandbox is the different directory /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38w1/<YourName>/), never look for the cases anywhere, and never run the round-38 counters (you have no key). A seat that touches those trees by mistake says so in its report's first line. The round-37 counter and key (revealed at 424aa248) are public: any seat may run them in its own sandbox clone.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no admission or verdict on the round. (An executor may spawn one read-only labrat probe for a falsifiable hypothesis; nothing else.)
- Your ONLY write paths are your sandbox /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38w1/<YourName>/ and your report file. Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any lane file other than your report — deliverables (code, fixtures, prose drafts, patches) stay in your sandbox; name their absolute paths and sha256 in the report; the L1 copies after review.
- Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git (show, log, ls-tree, diff) is fine. Never run any jj command at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin.
- Code that writes files or Git state runs only in your sandbox (clone with `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38w1/<YourName>/clone && git -C /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38w1/<YourName>/clone checkout -q 2dab7f3114f3e9dcf072b524c88816ab05fdfcf1`; export TMPDIR=/fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r38w1/<YourName>/tmp after creating it). Unset GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE before any git command. Cap every run with `timeout` (≤900 s), ≤8 parallel processes, and memory (e.g. `prlimit --as=4000000000`) for inputs that may blow up; kill any process tree you started before returning.
- Owned sites: no requests to the operator's web properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, operator *.onrender.com hosts, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io, any host in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json) unless your item names it.
- Network: only seats whose item names a public URL to open may fetch, GET only, ordinary means; never pass a bot challenge or access control; a page you cannot open is recorded as unopened.
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, record tool, version, channel and reason in your report). pacman guard (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): all pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide — install via uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R, no downgrade, no service restart.
- A provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch ends your item: write a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase. The only message target is agent://KakeR38 (the L1), for blockers only; never agent://all. Write plain English.

# Result
Report under 80 lines: what you built or attacked, exact commands with exit codes, observed outputs, evidence pointers (path:line, hash). An unrun check has not passed; say what you did not verify. Your findings are advisory input for the L1 and the non-author closure.
